stories.title: Man shot by ICE agent in New York City's Marble Hill, authorities say

en.title: Man shot by ICE agent in New York City's Marble Hill, authorities say
en.summary: An individual was hospitalized after being shot by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent in the Marble Hill neighborhood of New York City, according to Department of Homeland Security and city officials.

stories.title: ICE Agent Shoots and Wounds Man in New York City

en.title: ICE Agent Shoots and Wounds Man in New York City
en.summary: Federal officials stated they were attempting to detain an undocumented Dominican immigrant when an incident occurred, though authorities did not specify what led to the shooting.

stories.title: Hurricane Isaias threatens Gulf Coast with rain, flooding. See its path.

en.title: Hurricane Isaias threatens Gulf Coast with rain, flooding. See its path.
en.summary: Hurricane Isaias, the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026, strengthened to Category 2 status and is approaching the Gulf Coast from Mississippi to the Florida Panhandle with threats of rain and flooding.

stories.title: Fort Hood Shooter’s Execution Will Be Public and Streamed Live, Pentagon Says

en.title: Fort Hood Shooter's Execution Will Be Public and Streamed Live, Pentagon Says
en.summary: Military authorities announced that the scheduled firing squad execution of Major Nidal Malik Hasan on December 3 will be open to the public and broadcast online, marking the first such public execution in modern U.S. history if carried out.

stories.title: Pentagon will live stream Fort Hood shooter's execution, official says

en.title: Pentagon will live stream Fort Hood shooter's execution, official says
en.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan by firing squad will be publicly accessible through live streaming.

stories.title: Trump Administration Suspends Microsoft From Green Card Program, Alleging Visa Fraud

en.title: Trump Administration Suspends Microsoft From Green Card Program, Alleging Visa Fraud
en.summary: The Trump administration has suspended Microsoft from a green card program amid accusations that the company has abused the visa system. Vice President JD Vance highlighted Microsoft among multiple companies and universities facing similar allegations.

stories.title: Hasan execution will be live-streamed, Pentagon official says

en.title: Hasan execution will be live-streamed, Pentagon official says
en.summary: A Pentagon official announced that the execution of Nidal Hasan will be live-streamed publicly for viewing.

stories.title: Fort Hood shooter's execution will be livestreamed, Pentagon says

en.title: Fort Hood shooter's execution will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
en.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that the public will be able to watch the firing-squad execution of Nidal Hasan, an ex-Army major convicted of killing 13 people at Fort Hood in 2009.

stories.title: USS Lincoln docks in San Diego, returning home for first time in 321 days

en.title: USS Lincoln docks in San Diego, returning home for first time in 321 days
en.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln and more than 4,500 sailors completed a 321-day deployment and returned to their home port in San Diego.

stories.title: U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln Returns Home After Long and Grueling Deployment

en.title: U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln Returns Home After Long and Grueling Deployment
en.summary: The aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln returned home after an nearly 11-month deployment during which the crew faced food shortages and extended combat operations without rest days.

stories.title: Execution of Fort Hood shooter to be livestreamed

en.title: Execution of Fort Hood shooter to be livestreamed
en.summary: The Pentagon will livestream the execution of the Fort Hood shooter who killed 13 people in 2009. President Trump has ordered the execution to be carried out by firing squad.

stories.title: Pentagon says there will be a livestream of firing squad’s execution of the Fort Hood shooter

en.title: Pentagon says there will be a livestream of firing squad's execution of the Fort Hood shooter
en.summary: The Pentagon announced a livestream will be available for the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, scheduled for December 3 in Texas.

stories.title: Asian Currencies Mostly Consolidate; Focus on U.S. Data

en.title: Asian Currencies Mostly Consolidate; Focus on U.S. Data
en.summary: Most Asian currencies held steady against the U.S. dollar during morning trading as investors awaited upcoming U.S. economic data.

en.title: American Oil Refiners Are Printing Money as Wars Shrink Global Energy Supplies
en.summary: Independent U.S. oil refiners Valero Energy, Marathon Petroleum, and Phillips 66 are expected to report earnings that exceed their June quarter results amid constrained global energy supplies.

en.title: Oil Edges Lower; Prices Likely to Remain High in Short Term
en.summary: Oil prices declined modestly in Asian trading but remain at elevated levels in the near term.

stories.title: Gold Rises, Supported by Potential China Demand

en.title: Gold Rises, Supported by Potential China Demand
en.summary: Gold prices increased in Asian trading, supported by expectations that China's central bank will continue expanding its gold reserves.

stories.title: Nikkei Falls 1.1%, Dragged by Chip, Metals Stocks

en.title: Nikkei Falls 1.1%, Dragged by Chip, Metals Stocks
en.summary: The Nikkei index declined by 1.1% as Japanese stocks fell due to concerns about rising energy costs following increases in crude oil prices overnight.
